title: Writing / Brand Narrative / If Duolingo were a...
slide_intent: Translate personality into familiar cultural references so collaborators can align on a feeling before writing.
strategic_value: Illustrated references to a person, vehicle and song can give Duolingo’s team a shared vocabulary for its energy and accessibility.
demonstration: A vertical panel presents a celebrity, a green scooter and musicians under Celebrity, Vehicle and Song, each with explanatory copy.
practical_value: Use the analogies as creative calibration, while retaining their historical context rather than treating them as present endorsements.

content_islands.name: Guidance column
content_islands.spec: Place the personality subheading, analogy title and short framing paragraph at left.

content_islands.name: Worked examples
content_islands.spec: Stack the three illustrated cultural references at right, with the category label and explanatory paragraph accompanying each image.

reference_purposes.Intent: The framing text explicitly offers cultural touchstones for entering the brand’s state of mind.
reference_purposes.Expression: The illustrated analogies describe an accessible, stylish and upbeat personality.
